name: How do you manage dust and disruption during an open-concept kitchen conversion?

mainEntity.name: How do you manage dust and disruption during an open-concept kitchen conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: During an open-concept kitchen conversion, Opus Builders implements comprehensive measures to minimize dust and disruption. We utilize dust barriers, air scrubbers, and negative air pressure systems to contain debris. Daily site clean-up is performed, and pathways are protected. We communicate closely with homeowners about work schedules and provide temporary amenities where possible. Our goal is to maintain a safe and as comfortable living environment as possible throughout the renovation process, from demolition to final touches.
acceptedAnswer.description: We manage dust and disruption using barriers, air scrubbers, daily clean-ups, and clear communication to maintain a safe living environment.
